name: Amamiya Shiina
source:
Shiina is a girl who participated in the London Piano Contest with [url=/c10808]Haruka[/url]; Shiina ranked second after Haruka who ranked first. She transfers into [url=/c10817]Yuuto[/url]'s class at school. Her hobbies include playing the piano and the martial art of naginatajutsu. She always has a positive, cheerful and sociable personality. This makes her transition as a transfer student very easy. She used to live in Otaru, Hokkaido, Japan, though does not speak much of those days. She shows an interest for Yuuto as she believes there might be a reason they constantly bump into each other. She said one of the reason she chose Yuuto's school to transfer to is because of a famous teacher who graduated from the school and is known as the Performer of the Sunset is teaching at the school.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nogizaka_Haruka_no_Himitsu#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
